basic_info.description: Once a chocolate factory,  this NY-style brick bldg was transformed  into eleven live/work condos. Tucked away on a quiet alley in SoMa, this junior 1 bedroom is walking distance to fab restaurants, bars & specialty coffee roasters,  Inside, soaring ceilings and a flexible floor plan creates an open living space with a dramatic living/dining area underneath a huge industrial skylight. Adding to it's appeal is a remodeled kitchen with new appliances, a bedroom nook, and an exquisite custom bathroom, designed & built by award-winning architect Whitney Sander. This home also enjoys a wood-brng fireplace, walk-in closet, in-unit W/D and a shared roof deck with downtown views. Easy access to fwy, tech buses, CalTrain & bike lanes.
